subject.title: bug: Duplicate messages sent to Slack

question: Can a maintainer or operator correlate session agent:main:slack:channel:c0at0fztn85 with gateway delivery logs and Slack message timestamps to identify the duplicate-delivery path?
rationale: Source inspection shows adjacent guards but not the reported duplicate; the missing operational evidence is outside a read-only code review and determines whether this is already fixed or needs a targeted repair.

options.title: Keep Open For Log Correlation
options.body: Use the named session, gateway delivery logs, and Slack timestamps to map the duplicate to a known fixed class or a new Slack delivery bug.

options.title: Close Only If Logs Match A Shipped Fix
options.body: Close as implemented only after the duplicate can be tied to a specific shipped fix and release.

options.title: Request Fresh Reproduction
options.body: If the named logs are unavailable, ask for a new report with version, Slack timestamps, message IDs, and a minimal trigger.
